MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The black all-weather Gorilla tape closely matches tape I have bought before, and its weather resistance gives me a practical reason to choose it for outdoor repairs.",
    "The waterproof butt connectors complement my earlier crimp-terminal assortment by helping with wire splices, so they feel like a useful extension of my electrical repair supplies."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Concrete sealant, cutting wheels, and a wire wheel each require a particular project or compatible tool; my purchases of clamps and adhesives do not establish those needs.",
    "Clear repair tape and super glue fit my interests, but six rolls or ten tubes are more than I would choose without a specific job.",
    "The rapid test and reacher do not address a current need, and steel wool is only potentially useful rather than something I need now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair-supply purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any maintenance task, even though electrical connections, concrete sealing, and metal cutting serve different purposes.",
    "My Gorilla tape purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to offer other Gorilla products, although brand familiarity alone does not make a different adhesive or pack size useful."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The specific function matters: waterproof wire splices build on my connector purchases more naturally than supplies for an unrelated repair task.",
    "Quantity matters alongside product fit; my previous bulk tape purchase does not mean I currently need bulk quantities of clear tape or glue.",
    "I choose supplies selectively when they solve a concrete problem, so a possible future use is not enough to make me choose an item now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests but stretch them into unrelated projects and quantities I do not currently need."
}
